summary: Error-message prompt passes the first 8,000 characters of the whole post-submission page DOM as formHtml, which is usually head content rather than the form.
In-scan prompt cache key is sha1(template name, user message, image) and omits the model id and system prompt.
finding_type_hash is built from the tier constant passed as failureType (axe_violation, semantic, behavioral, ...), so different failure types under one criterion share a hash.

A criterion is marked passed when any one axe rule mapped to it passes on a page, and criterion results are upserted per page so the last page processed decides the stored status (a later not_applicable can replace an earlier passed). Only the first WCAG tag of a rule is used.
evidence: code: passesToCriterionResults, getWcagCriterion, upsertCriterionResult in the Tier 1 loop

summary: With page concurrency above 1, snapshots are pushed in completion order, so page order and the canonical page kept by cross-page deduplication vary between runs.
The submission interceptor blocks only POST document, fetch and XHR requests; GET form submissions navigate live during production scans.
evidence: code: setupRequestInterception continues every non-POST request

summary: URL-list mode skips robots.txt, and production crawls send the default headless user agent with no pacing between top-level loads.
evidence: code: robotsTxt = fixedList ? null : fetchText(...); no userAgent on newContext
